protocol: Exact80previously-opened training pairs. Native competence rechecked on160endpoints. Apply source-position MLP1 response induced by donor MLP0write only for76single-token pairs; four same-site normmatched random controls. No per-example correctness filtering, no fits, no evaluation rows.

pre_edit_text_examples: Review: The movie was wonderful. Sentiment:
Review: The book was wonderful. Sentiment:
John and Mary went to the library. John gave the letter to
John and Mary went to the school. John gave the bag to
The man behind the dog said that
The man beside the dog said that
The capital city of France is
The capital city of Italy is
The main language spoken in Italy is
The main language spoken in France is

limitations: Most families lack multiple pre-edit contexts for a fixed token pair.
Cohort gate >=75%both-endpoint binary and >=50%full-vocab top1; wrong examples retained.
number_successor has multi-token changes and is competence-only, not a failed response test.
Native donor response is an oracle target, not a learned generator.
